Skinny Blood Orange Crush
By: Karen Kelly
Published: Thursday, February 9, 2017 - 11:05pm

Ingredients




½ - ¾ cup fresh squeezed blood orange juice
1 oz triple sec
2 oz mandarin vodka
top off with club soda or seltzer
garnish with blood orange and lime
crushed ice

Preparation

1 Mix all ingredients except club soda in a cocktail shaker. 2 Pour over more crushed ice and top with club soda or seltzer. 3 Garnish and enjoy!

About

Is it five o'clock yet? This Skinny Blood Orange Crush is what you need this weekend. It's sweet, low in calories and filled with fresh blood orange juice. The perfect way to celebrate a long week.
